sections.title: Bench fixture — first interrupted full capture
sections.caption: Ten retained sports views. The bench fixture stopped because its action-menu setup did not retain the selected target; no collision or game-source failure was involved. Final full views and functional proof are in separate later sections.

sections.title: Bench fixture — second menu attempt
sections.caption: Two retained phone grove views before the same fixture action-menu selection timeout. Superseded by native E input in later attempts.

sections.title: Bench fixture — native sit and stand, first exit attempt
sections.caption: Four retained phone captures. Native E sat Eric and an arrow stood him up; the fixed arrow direction then walked off the canonical paving, so the fixture failed its navigation assertion. The final proof uses the normal walker to return to the pool walk.

sections.title: Bench fixture — second directional exit attempt
sections.caption: Four retained desktop captures. Sit and stand worked, but the fixture reused a directional basis across camera movement and its endpoint was outside canonical paving. This attempt is not a final result.

sections.title: Bench fixture — off-screen ground-tap attempt
sections.caption: Four retained desktop captures. Sit and stand worked; the distant pool-walk target projected outside the close follow viewport, so the fixture stopped before tapping. No camera framing was changed to make this test pass.

sections.title: Grove bench — final sit, stand and return proof
sections.caption: Both sizes pass native E sitting, native arrow standing and the normal walker returning to the pool walk. Retained morning/evening standing views, seated/standing close-ups and the reached public path. The route return uses the gameplay walker API; it is not claimed as a native pointer test.

sections.title: Northern sports — final tree clearance and maps
sections.caption: The two intersecting grove trunks now stand behind the unchanged service fence. Matching morning/evening public views and maps at both sizes. Desktop sports north-reverse starts outside the protected boundary; phone gym-tie roof occlusion already exists in the baseline. Both remain explicitly limited diagnostic frames.

sections.title: Northern sports — final tree-clearance native attempts
sections.caption: All 28 native walking and running-jump endpoint tests pass after moving the two trees. Deliberate reverse starts and near-building endpoints can obscure the actor; these are retained functional diagnostics.
